The breaking change occurred when logback upgraded from 1.2.x to 1.3.x/1.4.x - they migrated to require SLF4J 2.x API. The error `cannot access org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventAware` occurred because this interface was added in SLF4J 2.x.

**Fix Applied:** Updated `slf4j-api` from version `1.7.36` to `2.0.3` in `/pay-adminusers/pom.xml`.

Both `mvn compile` and `mvn test-compile` now succeed.
